text: And it was at the end of days. That Cayin worked the ground, he brought an offering to God in the place where he established his prayer. And it is not correct in my eyes the words of those (i.e. Rashi) who say that when he brought an offering to his father (in heaven) that you can infer that he did not bring it from his first fruits because by Hevel’s offering it says “from his firstborn flock” (and the word “first” is not mentioned by Cayin’s offering).
Its meaning is: To eastern land. And so: ...
After he mentioned the generations of Ishmael, he returned to mention the generations of Isaac, which are Esau and Jacob.

And there are those who say that the meaning of begot Isaac: that he resembled his father, and all who saw him would testify that Abraham begot him. And there are those who say that the meaning of begot: raised and brought up, like "were brought up upon the knees of Joseph" (Genesis 50:23). And the proof: For he said: "And he sent them away from upon Isaac, his son" (Genesis 25:6).
Since the word בני (children of) uses the construct state, the children will be the fourth [generation].
